Sandbox_MultiTow_Enabled_tooltip: Off = vanilla towing (one vehicle or trailer only). Requires the mod's Java part (ZombieBuddy) on the server and on every client.
Sandbox_MultiTow_RequireHook: Require Heavy Chain Hook from the 3rd vehicle on
Sandbox_MultiTow_RequireHook_tooltip: Coupling a third or further vehicle uses up one Heavy Chain Hook. Detaching gives it back; if the link snaps, a Heavy Chain and a Large Hook drop on the ground.
Sandbox_MultiTow_HazardAuto_tooltip: Coupling a vehicle switches on the hazard lights of the train. The driver can switch them off in the vehicle radial menu (V).
Sandbox_MultiTow_Wear_tooltip: Links wear out while driving, faster under heavy load. Chains wear about three times faster than tow bars. At 0 %% the link snaps.
Sandbox_MultiTow_CargoWeight_tooltip: How much of the cargo adds to the weight of vehicles in a train. Off = the game's own calculation.
Sandbox_MultiTow_MaxVehiclesCar: Cars: maximum vehicles in a train
Sandbox_MultiTow_MaxVehiclesCar_tooltip: Applies when the towing vehicle (the first vehicle) is a car. Counts all vehicles including the towing vehicle. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_MultiTow_BoostCar_tooltip: Extra power for a car pulling more than one vehicle. Automatic grows with every additional towed vehicle.
Sandbox_MultiTow_MaxVehiclesTruck: Trucks and vans: maximum vehicles in a train
Sandbox_MultiTow_MaxVehiclesTruck_toolti: Applies when the towing vehicle is a pickup, van, step van, truck or ambulance. 0 = unlimited.
Sandbox_MultiTow_BoostTruck: Trucks and vans: extra engine power
Sandbox_MultiTow_BoostTruck_tooltip: Extra power for a truck or van pulling more than one vehicle. Automatic grows with every additional towed vehicle.
Sandbox_MultiTow_AssistPower_tooltip: A towed vehicle with its engine running drives along with this share of its own engine power when the towing vehicle accelerates. 0 = off. Only works when the extra engine power is Off for cars and for trucks/vans.
Sandbox_MultiTow_SpeedUnit_tooltip: Unit of the two speed limit values below.
Sandbox_MultiTow_BrakeCar_tooltip: How hard the towed vehicles brake along when the towing vehicle brakes. 0 = not at all (vanilla), 100 = as if someone were braking in each of them.
Sandbox_MultiTow_SpeedLimitCar_tooltip: Top speed for trains with 3 or more vehicles, in the unit chosen above. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelModeCar_tooltip: Extra fuel used by the towing vehicle from the 3rd vehicle on. Even = the percentage is added once per additional vehicle. Exponential = it grows faster with every additional vehicle.
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelPercentCar_tooltip: Example with 20 %% and 4 towed vehicles: Even = 1.6x, Exponential = 1.73x.
Sandbox_MultiTow_NoiseCar_tooltip: A moving train makes noise at every link. Chains are loud, tow bars much quieter.
Sandbox_MultiTow_BrakeTruck_tooltip: Like above, for trains pulled by a truck or van.
Sandbox_MultiTow_SpeedLimitTruck_tooltip: Top speed for trains with 3 or more vehicles, in the unit chosen above. 0 = no limit.
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelModeTruck: Trucks and vans: extra fuel use
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelModeTruck_tooltip: Like above, for trains pulled by a truck or van.
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelPercentTruck: Trucks and vans: extra fuel per vehicle (%%)
Sandbox_MultiTow_FuelPercentTruck_toolti: Example with 20 %% and 4 towed vehicles: Even = 1.6x, Exponential = 1.73x.
Sandbox_MultiTow_NoiseTruck: Trucks and vans: noise attracts zombies
Sandbox_MultiTow_NoiseTruck_tooltip: A moving train makes noise at every link. Chains are loud, tow bars much quieter.
